project_metadata.name: KaraokeZero
project_metadata.tagline: The Headless, Ultra-Low Resource PiKaraoke Appliance
project_metadata.repository_strategy: Independent Wrapper/Appliance (Downloads and configures the latest upstream PiKaraoke version)
project_metadata.core_philosophy: Ultra-low resource consumption, headless operation, zero GUI overhead, zero audio latency, and KMS/DRM hardware acceleration.
project_metadata.target_hardware: Any Raspberry Pi (Highly optimized for low-spec models like Raspberry Pi Zero W / RPi 3)

hardware_topology.processing_unit: Raspberry Pi Zero W (Booting OS from SD Card)

storage.sd_card_internal: Dedicated strictly to OS, Python 3.11+ environments, application configs, and scripts (Wear Leveling Protection: HIGH).
storage.hard_drive_external: USB HDD mounted via fstab to '/mnt/external_hd/karaoke'. Dedicated to local media library, persistent DB SQLite, and yt-dlp download buffer.

hardware_topology.video_output: Mini-HDMI to VGA Adapter connected to a USB-powered LED Monitor.

audio_routing.strategy: Zero CPU Overhead & Zero Mic Latency
audio_routing.extraction: Audio extracted via the P2 (3.5mm) analog output native to the HDMI-to-VGA adapter.
audio_routing.mixing: Direct physical connection from the adapter's P2 port to an external Multichannel Audio Mixer (e.g., 4-channel analog mixer).
audio_routing.microphones: Connected directly to the external analog mixer to guarantee zero software delay.

software_stack.operating_system: Raspberry Pi OS Lite (Bookworm 32-bit - Headless, No X11/Wayland Desktop Environment)

karaoke_core_service.execution_mode: Strictly background daemon running under Python 3.11+

software_stack.media_player: VLC Media Player (CLI via cvlc wrapper)
software_stack.video_rendering_engine: Direct Rendering Manager (KMS/DRM) / Hardware Acceleration via V4L2

wifi_manager.purpose: Dynamic and lightweight captive-style portal for network selection without a monitor.
logic_flow: 1. NetworkManager is pre-configured to prioritize the Admin's Mobile Hotspot (Priority 100).
2. If no known venue WiFi is found, Pi connects to the Admin Hotspot.
3. User accesses Flask Web UI via smartphone (e.g., http://<admin-ip>:8888).
4. Flask app executes 'nmcli -t -f SSID,SIGNAL dev wifi' and displays a clean HTML list.
5. User selects the Venue WiFi and inputs password.
6. Flask app registers new network (Priority 50) and connects, moving Pi to the venue's network.

orchestrator.purpose: Background service to monitor PiKaraoke state and manage the physical display seamlessly via DRM.
logic_flow: 1. On boot, detect active IP (wlan0). Use 'qrencode' to generate a QR Code (http://<ip>:5555) and save to '/tmp/qrcode.png'.
2. Enter infinite loop polling PiKaraoke API ('http://127.0.0.1:5555/api/queue') every 1-2 seconds.

3. IDLE STATE ('is_playing' == false): Spawn 'cvlc' playing a local looping background video. Use VLC logo filter ('--sub-source logo --logo-file /tmp/qrcode.png --logo-position 9') to overlay the QR Code directly onto the DRM framebuffer. Command includes: '--vout drm'.
4. PLAYING STATE ('is_playing' == true): Kill the idle video instance. Spawn a new 'cvlc' instance rendering the requested track via hardware acceleration ('--fullscreen --no-osd --vout drm').
5. Track ends -> VLC auto-closes -> Daemon detects 'is_playing' == false -> Re-spawns IDLE STATE.

installer.purpose: Automated 'One-Click' deployment script to transform a fresh Bookworm OS into the KaraokeZero Appliance.
actions: Install dependencies: vlc, python3-flask, network-manager, qrencode, yt-dlp.
Clone official upstream PiKaraoke repository from vicwomg/pikaraoke (always latest master).
Create and enable systemd services (wifi_manager.service, orchestrator.service, pikaraoke.service).

performance_and_stability_guarantees.ram_management: VLC processes are killed between tracks, preventing memory leaks. No Chromium/browsers exist on the Pi.
performance_and_stability_guarantees.cpu_management: DRM handles video decoding in hardware. Audio extracted natively via HDMI passthrough.
performance_and_stability_guarantees.sd_card_protection: All heavy read/write operations (SQLite, downloads, media buffering) are forcefully routed to the external HDD.
